what: FYI from compile-time-sched: brief item 4 (delete the per-process compile-time path) is met by your blaze-cargo/src/cargo/ deletion (compile_time.rs, own_script.rs, own_macro.rs gone, no caller left); I deleted nothing. Stale prose naming them, yours to sweep if you like: harness/wasmcmacro.py:9 docstring (compile_time.rs) and the reason string at crates/blaze-cargo/src/toolchain/own.rs:756 (own_macro.rs). Also: blaze_codegen::Build::run may now block its calling thread waiting for another concurrent build to land a shared function (blaze_codegen::flight); it never holds a claim while waiting, so no deadlock, but it holds that plane worker meanwhile.
